  No, the transform layer doesn't store any data

  It only generates the SQL. The warehouse is where the data lives.

      RAW -->|"UNION ALL + tenantId"| STG["stg_app (26 tables)<br/>★ EVERYTHING MERGES HERE"]
      STG --> CORE["app (50 tables)<br/>business rules: suggestion,<br/>promoted, restock, nearby, orders…"]
      CORE --> BI["bi_app (80 views)<br/>reporting layer"]

      EXT["External sources:<br/>tracker · analytics · sonar"] --> BI
      INT["app_internal<br/>(internal reference)"] --> CORE

  The exact point where it stops being per tenant is stg_app. Every table there is
  a UNION ALL of all tenants, each row stamped with tenantId.
